In partnership with Dedalus Healthcare Systems Group

Dedalus is a leading healthcare IT provider with over 30 offices worldwide and more than 200 implementations globally. The partnership brings over 200 healthcare applications to South Africa, including the IHE-compliant X Values interoperability platform.

About Faranani

Founded in 2004, we are a Level 1 BB-BEE ICT systems integration company with deep roots in the healthcare, financial, manufacturing, public safety and security, and transport industries.

We have a proud track record in assessing, designing and implementing world-class technology solutions for world-class companies. We attract and recruit the finest ICT professionals, approximately 70% of whom are from previously disadvantaged backgrounds.

PAIA and POPIA

Under the Promotion of Access to Information Act (PAIA), we provide the guides and forms you need to access information, lodge complaints or request records.

  • PAIA guideEnglish and Afrikaans
  • Form 1Request for a copy of the guide
  • Form 2Request for access to a record
  • Form 5Complaint form

Under the Protection of Personal Information Act (POPIA), public and private bodies must register their Information Officers with the Information Regulator (section 55). Information Officers are appointed automatically by virtue of their positions and may delegate duties to Deputy Information Officers.

Website privacy statement (effective 11 May 2020)

Applies to Faranani IT Services (Pty) Ltd, Faranani Healthcare Solutions (Pty) Ltd, Faranani Doctec (Pty) Ltd and faranani.com.

  • We only collect information you voluntarily give us by email or direct contact, and we never sell or rent it.
  • We use it to respond to you. We share it outside Faranani only as needed to fulfil your request.
  • Unless you opt out, we may email you about new products, services or policy changes.
  • You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, or raise a concern, at any time.
  • We use cookies to improve access and recognise repeat visitors. Partners may use their own cookies, which we cannot control.
  • If you feel we are not abiding by this policy, call +27 11 805 2012 or email info@faranani.com.

Policy documents

Data protection policies and notices that apply to Faranani. To exercise your rights, email the Information Officer at dpo.group@dedalus.eu. You can also complain to the Information Regulator at inforeg@justice.gov.za.

    Download PDF 246 KB
    Key points
    • Applies to every Dedalus Group company and employee worldwide, including Faranani
    • Five commitments: fair and lawful collection, respecting individual rights, secure management, data protection by design and default, and cooperation with regulators
    • Sensitive data (health, biometric, religion, political opinions, criminal records) is used only where necessary and access is restricted
  • Information Notice for Job ApplicantsDedalus Job Applicant Information Notice, v3. Updated August 2025
    Download PDF 158 KB
    Key points
    • Covers Dedalus Southern Africa (Pty) Ltd and Faranani Healthcare Solutions (Pty) Ltd
    • Unsuccessful applications are kept for up to 6 months after the process ends
    • Interview video surveillance images are kept for a maximum of 30 days
    • No sale of data, no direct marketing and no decisions based solely on automated profiling
  • Information Notice for Clients and ProspectsDedalus Information Notice for Clients and Prospects, v1. Updated October 2025
    Download PDF 162 KB
    Key points
    • For people acting on behalf of a client or prospect: identification and professional data
    • Kept for up to 7 years after the contract with a client ends
    • Marketing is based on consent, or on legitimate interest for similar products, and you can object at any time
    • Your data is not sold
  • Privacy Policy and Information Notice for Website UsersDedalus Privacy Policy and Information Notice for Website Users, v1. Updated October 2025
    Download PDF 183 KB
    Key points
    • Covers identification, professional and technical data collected when you use the site or write to us
    • Enquiries are kept for a maximum of 3 years from our last contact
    • Marketing messages are sent only with your specific consent, which you can withdraw
  • Information Notice for Suppliers and Business PartnersDedalus Information Notice for Suppliers and Business Partners, v1. Updated October 2025
    Download PDF 141 KB
    Key points
    • For people acting on behalf of a supplier, service provider or business partner
    • Kept for up to 7 years after the relationship ends
    • Shared only on a need-to-know basis with service providers, Dedalus Group companies and authorities. Your data is not sold
